name: Ass and Thighs Slider - (Krea-2 + ZIT)
description: Krea-2: A bit more ass-heavy compared to Z. Should be pretty stable. Much more effective at close range, so the strength will also change at different ranges . Recommended range: -6 to 6 Recommended far away subject: -9 to 9 ZIT: This LoRA is part of a batch from my personal collection that I've decided to release publicly. Because I'm putting out many at once, these haven't gone through the same extensive testing I usually do before release - but they've all been in active use in my own workflow for a while. A lot of sliders on Civitai target the same concepts, and I know how hard it can be to tell the well-made ones apart from the broken ones. What I can promise is that anything I release is a proper quality slider: it does what it says, it doesn't wreck your image, and it combines cleanly with others. I recently stacked over 20 of my own LoRAs on a single generation and the output still came out great - so piling several of mine together is a safe bet for most situations. Feedback and bug reports are welcome in the comments. Recommended range is what i use in the sample image (tiny text at the bottom of the images) All my work is 100% free. The only thing that really matters to me is people leaving a review , good or bad . I will NEVER remove or block anyone for leaving a bad review, so don't be afraid to give me criticism. I'm stating this because when a creator blocks someone for leaving a bad review, that person can no longer see any of the creator's models, essentially muting their critics. This is something I'm highly critical of, and I believe it's a fundamental quality problem on this site.
